mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.35 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.35M, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, indicating an imminent economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of further rate hikes and raises equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 720 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 720B, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate investment and earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
